name: Harbin University of Science and Technology

evidence.summary: Harbin University of Science and Technology says it has been co-built by the Heilongjiang Provincial Government and SASTIND since 2015, and was chosen again for the next round of that arrangement in 2022.
The university's own overview lists five defence-specialty discipline directions among its disciplines.
A Heilongjiang provincial university since 1998, when it was transferred to the province under joint central and local administration with the province in charge.
